# SpectralDimension

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A measure of the effective dimensionality of a network's Laplacian spectrum, determining how diffusion or wave propagation scales with distance. Governs whether nonreciprocal phase oscillator networks exhibit critical dynamics, linking topology to computational capacity in neuromorphic substrates.
